patch_description:
This crossover keeps the stronger regime-aware ideas from the better-performing scripts, but shifts the feature set toward shorter, more stationary lookbacks to reduce train-to-validation slope collapse. It adds rolling z-normalized returns, short-window volatility/efficiency/autocorrelation trends, compact regime transition features, and a few multiplicative interactions that often generalize better than raw levels. 

On the model side, it slightly increases expressivity versus the most collapsed configurations while keeping enough regularization and a modest tree depth to avoid overfitting. The feature set stays comfortably below the 80-feature cap and uses only past data.
